site.notes: Bog area from National Hydrography Dataset.  Added on 7/1/21 by Grace Roper, UW-Madison.  Lake-area scripts available at https://github.com/NeotomaDB/neotoma_lakes

chronology.notes: Depth/date scatter suggest straight line least-square fit to 5 dates plus top. 5 C-14 dates plus ragweed rise above 120 cm, which is assigned a date of 300 yr bp. Age bounds for application of the model: top = 0; bottom = 13000.

site.sitedescription: Poor fen dominated by black spruce (Picea mariana), tamarack (Larix laricina), and an understory of ericaceous shrubs and Sphagnum mosses
